title: Steamed Venezuelan Ceviche
description: A refreshing and light Venezuelan-inspired dish, perfect for warm weather. Steaming the fish instead of marinating it maintains its delicate flavor and texture.

ingredients.name: Fresh white fish (such as sea bass or snapper)
ingredients.notes: Ask your fishmonger for the freshest catch

ingredients.name: Fresh lime juice
ingredients.notes: Use a manual or electric juicer for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Freshly squeezed orange juice
ingredients.notes: Choose a mix of navel and blood oranges for a tangy flavor

ingredients.name: Chopped red onion
ingredients.notes: Use a mandoline to get thin, even slices

ingredients.name: Chopped fresh cilantro
ingredients.notes: Choose fresh cilantro with no signs of wilting

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Freshly squeezed aji amarillo pepper juice (optional)
ingredients.notes: Use aji amarillo peppers for a traditional Venezuelan flavor

instructions: Rinse the fish under cold water and pat it dry with paper towels.
Cut the fish into small pieces and place it in a steamer basket.
Steam the fish over boiling water for 8-10 minutes, or until it's cooked through.
In a separate bowl, mix together the lime juice, orange juice, red onion, cilantro, salt, and pepper.
Add the steamed fish to the bowl and toss it with the marinade.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
If using aji amarillo pepper juice, stir it in just before serving.
Serve the ceviche immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
